name: dingbat-web-tests
description: Test-only manifest for the dingbat web front-end. Deliberately has NO "type":"module" so the existing UMD/CommonJS scripts (sdputil.js) still load as CommonJS from the .mjs tests; the tests themselves are ESM by their .mjs extension. The only devDependency is Playwright, used by render.test.mjs (headless-Chromium WebGL2 pixel-readback guard) and manualpair.test.mjs (symmetric manual-code WebRTC pairing guard). Install with `npm ci` (or `npm install`) then `npx playwright install --with-deps chromium`.
